WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    tc.telescope_count::DECIMAL / (SELECT COUNT(*)::DECIMAL FROM telescopes) as share,
    AVG(tc.telescope_count::DECIMAL / (SELECT COUNT(*)::DECIMAL FROM telescopes)) 
      OVER () as avg_share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - avg_share as diff_from_avg
  FROM shares_calc
  WHERE share > avg_share
),
with_row_num AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    diff_from_avg,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC) as rn
  FROM filtered
),
tenth_threshold AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT diff_from_avg FROM with_row_num WHERE rn = 10 LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT MIN(diff_from_avg) FROM with_row_num)
    ) as threshold
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  diff_from_avg
FROM with_row_num
WHERE diff_from_avg >= (SELECT threshold FROM tenth_threshold)
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC

assumptions.assumption: Only observatories with at least one telescope record are included in the analysis. Observatories with zero telescopes do not appear.
The average share is calculated as the arithmetic mean across all observatories that have telescopes, not weighted by any other factor.
